scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: cross-env NODE_ENV=test node scripts/crearBasePruebas.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=test vitest run tests/integration --reporter=verbose
scripts.test:tz: npm run test:tz:guayaquil && npm run test:tz:utc
scripts.test:tz:guayaquil: cross-env NODE_ENV=test TZ=America/Guayaquil npm run test:unit && cross-env NODE_ENV=test TZ=America/Guayaquil npm run test:integration
scripts.test:tz:utc: cross-env NODE_ENV=test TZ=UTC npm run test:unit && cross-env NODE_ENV=test TZ=UTC npm run test:integration
